stem.en: The chapter gives the length of India's coastline as an exact figure. How long is India's coastline, in kilometres?

explanation.en: The coastline of India is 11,098.81 kilometres long. That length is one of the reasons the country needs an early warning system, a cyclone shelter network and rescue teams all along the coast, and one of the reasons the question of what the sea gives back is worth asking.

hints.en: It is a little over eleven thousand kilometres. The chapter gives the figure to two decimal places.
